Values.//: PCR service ingestion endpoint. Path is ingress prefix /pcr + the service's POST /internal/hearing-results. Required. Replace <pcr-service-ingress-host> with the per-environment internal ingress host from the platform team - deliberately not recorded in this public repo.

Path to a PEM bundle of extra CA certs to trust, on top of the JVM defaults. Required in Azure: the PCR internal ingress uses a private CA the JVM does not ship. Provision the bundle onto the app (e.g. WEBSITE_LOAD_CERTIFICATES exposes certs under /var/ssl/certs) - it is NOT committed here, this repo is public. Leave unset locally.
Optional ingress header. The endpoint is security:[] (network-isolated), so leave both unset unless an ingress in front of it requires one.
Outbound HTTP tuning. All optional; defaults shown.
